housing.summary: Numbeo reports EUR 614.40 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Valladolid city centre: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Valladolid. Spain's Urban Leases Act sets the mandatory housing deposit at one month's rent: https://www.boe.es/eli/es/l/1994/11/24/29/. Idealista has a Valladolid-city rental listings portal: https://www.idealista.com/alquiler-viviendas/valladolid-valladolid/.

banking.summary: BBVA's official guidance says foreign applicants use, depending on status, NIE (EU residents), TIE (non-EU residents), or passport (resident or non-resident foreigners, with branch attendance); BBVA may additionally request a payslip, employment contract, or latest IRPF return: https://www.bbva.es/finanzas-vistazo/tu-guia-bbva/cuentas/como-abrir-una-cuenta-bancaria-en-espana-si-eres-extranjero.html.
required_docs: NIE for an EU resident applicant, TIE for a non-EU resident applicant, or passport for a resident or non-resident foreign applicant applying at a branch
BBVA may additionally request a payslip, employment contract, or latest IRPF return

schools.summary: British curriculum is available at International School of Valladolid: https://colegio-internacional-valladolid.dukeseducation.es/en/. The Junta de Castilla y León lists the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme in Valladolid: https://www.educa.jcyl.es/es/informacion/sistema-educativo/bachillerato/bachillerato. The Ministry of Education's national non-university school directory is: https://www.educacionfpydeportes.gob.es/contenidos/centros-docentes/buscar-centro-no-universitario.html.

legal_admin.summary: A newcomer taking up residence in Valladolid should register an alta in the Padrón Municipal de Habitantes with Valladolid City Council's population service: https://www.valladolid.es/es/temas/hacemos/padron-habitantes.
legal_admin.registration_step: Register an alta in the Padrón Municipal de Habitantes with Valladolid City Council's population service.

tax_finance.summary: For an individual, Spain's tax identification number (NIF) generally coincides with the DNI or NIE. A foreign individual without an NIE who needs to carry out a tax-relevant transaction can request a NIF from the Agencia Tributaria: https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/censos-nif-domicilio-fiscal/solicitar-nif/nif-persona-fisica.html.
tax_finance.tax_id_name: NIF (generally the NIE for a foreign individual)

transport.summary: Valladolid's AUVASA urban bus network offers the ordinary Bono30 at EUR 22.80 for 30 days of unlimited travel: https://www.auvasa.es/tarifas-y-medios-de-pago/. Spain's DGT says residents may exchange licences from EU/EEA countries and countries with an exchange agreement, plus professional licences from countries without an agreement: https://www.dgt.es/nuestros-servicios/permisos-de-conducir/permisos-extranjeros-y-de-fuerzas-y-cuerpos-de-seguridad/canjes-de-permisos/canjes-de-permisos-extranjeros/index.html. For public healthcare in Valladolid, apply for the SACYL health card at the health centre assigned to the home address with the documentation required for the applicant's status: https://www.saludcastillayleon.es/es/serviciosonline/tarjeta-sanitaria/informacion-procedimiento.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Residents may exchange licences issued by EU/EEA countries or countries with an exchange agreement; professional licences from countries without an agreement may also be exchangeable. Requirements depend on the issuing country.
transport.healthcare_registration: Apply for the SACYL health card at the health centre assigned to the home address. Generally bring DNI/NIE for holder and beneficiaries and proof of insured or beneficiary status; EU/EEA/Swiss nationals also use passport or national ID plus Central Register of Foreigners certificate, while other-country nationals use a residence permit.
